decisions.reason: Certified gasketed plate exchangers for HVAC rest directly on the firm's core plate know-how, so it can keep interpreting market feedback and refining the line despite no recent website signals.
The marine box cooler line draws on deep water-cooling expertise and a stated major market share, giving strong related knowledge and a solid commercial base.
The single marine cooling unit overlaps with the box cooler competence and service network, so it stays useful, though as a single model it is more exposed to consolidation into the main marine line.
The compact oil cooler line applies existing exchanger engineering and manufacturing knowledge to adjacent applications, so the firm can assimilate feedback and improve it at low cost.

Enhanced tubes build on the firm's own heat-transfer R&D and EU project experience, but the earlier withdrawal of the related finned tube suggests some risk of rationalising tube products into the portfolio.
